note: Sokoto's digital economy ministry says (1 Oct 2026) the next phase must connect government institutions and needs reliable connectivity across ministries and the 23 local government areas, and that its 2027 budget proposals name connectivity; it states no existing connection at any local government office and names no system, so there is no fact. The state ministry and its ICT agency (SICTDA, law passed April 2025) are upper-tier bodies.
